summary: Renders a particle set with a color fade derived from input a2. When (int)(a2 * 254.0) is nonzero it optionally triggers AIWaypointPathCheckerRenderer, then writes a packed color/alpha value into all four pixel attributes of every element in the pointer array at this[26] (count from this[25]). When the scaled input is zero it delegates to sub_4CB5E0 if elements exist.

operations.description: Scale the fade input: v8 = a2 * 254.0 and v3 = (int)v8; the 254.0 scale constant corresponds to flt_5ACEC4.
If v3 is nonzero run the fade-render path.
If this[22] > 0 and this[25] == 0 trigger the waypoint checker render.
AIWaypointPathCheckerRenderer((int)dword_5EA2C0) renders the AI waypoint path checker visualization.
result = this[25] (element count) and v5 = (v3 << 24) + 0xFFFFFF (packed alpha plus full color).
Loop over the element array: for i = 0 .. this[25] - 1.
v7 = *(_DWORD **)(this[26] + 4 * i): read the i-th element pointer from the array at this[26].
PixelAttributeWriteToTexture(*v7, 0, v5) through PixelAttributeWriteToTexture(*v7, 3, v5): write the packed value into the element's four pixel attributes.
Else branch: when v3 == 0 and this[25] > 0 delegate to sub_4CB5E0(this).
Return result (the last read element count, or the result of sub_4CB5E0).

unresolved: Meaning of the four per-element pixel attributes (0..3) is not established beyond 'written to texture'.
Whether the 254.0 scale is loaded from flt_5ACEC4 or an inlined literal is unresolved.
The fallback sub_4CB5E0 behavior for the zero-fade case is unknown.
